_: The choir book's Lombardic alphabet, second hand: Free Library of Philadelphia Lewis E 73 (Gradual, Bologna?, c. 1425; Internet Archive lewis_e_073), one hand of red and blue filigree Lombards throughout. Traced with tools/tracelomb.py (STAFF=.035 COL=red|blue CENTER=.04 BOPEN=.001 BODY=.55 WINB=.015) from the full-size page images; sources in research/choirbook/le073/ (the page in each file's src). Composed letters say so. Units: each source letter's height = 1. tools/lombcompose.py fairs every letter (FAIR).
